這是 Sophisticated Storage In Motion 的官方 Fabric 版本。

欲了解更多資訊，請查看 P3pp3rF1y 的官方頁面 [Sophisticated Storage In Motion](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage-in-motion)。

此模組需要 [Sophisticated Core (Unofficial Fabric Port)](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-core-(unofficial-fabric-port) 和 [Sophisticated Storage (Unofficial Fabric Port)](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage-(unofficial-fabric-port))。

也在尋找後背包模組嗎？看看 [Sophisticated Backpacks (Unofficial Fabric Port)!](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage-(unofficial-fabric-port))
